description: 专利规避设计、绕开专利。当用户说「怎么绕开这件专利」「竞品专利怎么规避」「我的产品想避开这个专利」「哪些特征可以替换掉」「规避设计思路」时使用。输出规避设计思路表（Excel 能打开），每条思路附替代方案的专利检索结果。初步思路，不构成法律意见。 Design-around ideas for a patent. Breaks the independent claim into features, suggests ways to drop, replace or change each one, and checks whether the alternatives hit other patents. Preliminary ideas only.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
